g.text: ADVANCED IOT CONTROLLER — OPTIMAL 4-QUADRANT PCB ARCHITECTURE
Isolated High Voltage | Dedicated Relay Actuation | Direct-Aligned MCU Busses | Organized Front-Panel Sensors & LEDs
• Creepage: Physical Milled FR4 Air Gap
Active-LOW Opto Driving: IN4, IN3, IN2, IN1
• JST1 GPIOs (Active-LOW) ──► IN1, IN2, IN3, IN4
ACTUATION BUS HIGHWAY (STRAIGHT DOWN TO ZONE 3):
• Control lines D14, D27, D26, D25 route vertically straight down into the ESP32 Right Header.
• No crossing over analog sensor lines or 230V AC lines.
• Trace Width: ≥ 0.50mm (20 mil) for robust relay driving margins.
• Relay coils draw zero current from ESP32 3.3V rail (strictly opto LED current ~3mA).
Wall Switches: SW1, SW2, SW3, SW4
• Top & Bottom GND Copper Planes | 1 oz (35µm) Finished Copper
• AC Trace Width ≥ 2.5mm (100mil) | DC Power Trunk ≥ 1.2mm (48mil)
• 4 Distinct Quadrants | 100% Perimeter Plug-in | Zero Wires Across Board
